card.name: Separators in study-design lists and risk lists
card.fires_on: Spaces and separators between fields in clinical trial 'Study Design' blocks, and commas right after heart attack or stroke in lists of estrogen or NSAID risks.

modes.label: Trial design field breaks
modes.description: The space or bar between fields like Allocation, Masking, and Primary Purpose in a trial record.

modes.label: Commas in cardiovascular risk lists
modes.description: The comma after heart attacks or stroke, just before the next risk such as strokes, breast cancer, or blood clots.
